summary: Construct an Electron-compatible native window wrapper when renderer requirements are supported by the selected backend.

target.notes: Create a native window abstraction and preserve Electron option defaults relevant to translated code.

semantics.side_effects: creates OS window and renderer host

caveats: Electron BrowserWindow cannot be constructed before app readiness.
webPreferences and Chromium-specific options may force runtime fallback even if outer-window behavior is native.

tests.name: construct after ready
tests.input: await app.whenReady(); const w = new BrowserWindow({width:800,height:600});
tests.expected_behavior: creates a window with requested dimensions after host readiness

tests.name: construct too early
tests.expected_behavior: must fail or be rejected when invoked before the application ready boundary, matching Electron
